synthesis: SendEndOfShiftSummary dies on never-closed multi-week shifts. Two deterministic input-size failures on the same path: (1) BuildShiftSummary.php:262 Hit::whereIn('scan_id', $orderedScanIds) hits PostgreSQL's 65535 bind-parameter limit; (2) the zone ST_Contains query, already fenced by DEV-2325's MATERIALIZED CTE, still hit 57014 statement timeout on a 17-day window (kit 175, shift 20, 2026-08-17). The job retries 5 times on the same input, then records build_failed. Outcome required by the ticket: no HY000; zone query bounded so a multi-week shift cannot timeout; do not blindly retry deterministic size failures; pin with a pathological-cardinality test.

scope.summary: Cap every BuildShiftSummary query window to the last 8 hours of the shift; replace whereIn(scan_id) with whereIntegerInRaw; set SendEndOfShiftSummary::$tries = 2.

proposed_changes.change: Clamp the UTC read window to last 8 hours (SUMMARY_WINDOW_HOURS). Replace whereIn('scan_id') with whereIntegerInRaw. Keep the DEV-2325 MATERIALIZED CTE.
proposed_changes.reason: Line 262 is the HY000 site; the CTE fence did not stop a 17-day 57014.

proposed_changes.change: Set public int $tries = 2. No skip path. Keep failed() mail_failed vs build_failed.
proposed_changes.reason: Retries cannot change a deterministic input-size failure.

proposed_changes.reason: AC4. Tests already exist; candidates that said otherwise were wrong.

questions.q: For a pathological shift (17-day / >65,535 scans): produce a bounded last-N-hours summary, skip+log, or still attempt the full window (chunk/raw-IN / server-side join)?
questions.answer: Option A — bounded last-N-hours summary (not skip, not full window).

questions.q: If bounded summary: what is N? EnsureOpenShift already uses LOOKBACK_HOURS=24 and MAX_SCAN_ROWS=5000 when inferring shift start — 24h matches the intended workday-sized shift.
questions.answer: N = 8 hours. Query window is max(started_at, ended_at - 8h).

questions.q: If skip: silent summary_skipped_reason only, or also email 'summary unavailable'? New reason string (too_large / shift_too_long) vs reuse build_failed?
AC3 retry: catch HY000/57014 in handle and fail immediately (keep $tries=5 for transient errors), or set $tries=1 for the whole job?

notes: All three candidates agreed: line 262 is the HY000 site; fail-fast on deterministic size errors; callers need no code change; scale_relevant=true.

Disagreement resolved from ground truth: AC2 is NOT satisfied by DEV-2325 alone (prod 57014 on the 17-day CTE window). Tests DO exist. kit 175's 15.6M is lifetime scans, not the 17-day window (ticket said tens of thousands of ids, which still cleared 65535).

Disagreement left open (do not silently pick): skip vs last-N summary vs full-window attempt; whereIntegerInRaw vs chunked whereIn vs server-side hits⋈zones join (repo convention favors whereIntegerInRaw for the param limit; a join still helps if the PHP id list is huge); skip-reason string; skip email.
Rejected: LIMIT 100 on zone rows; Scan::factory() for 70k rows (wrong connection); 10k skip threshold (a busy 8h shift at 1–2 scans/s is ~29k–58k).
EnsureOpenShift LOOKBACK_HOURS=24 / MAX_SCAN_ROWS=5000 is a grounded product precedent for a workday-sized window, not a license to assume 24h.
Phase 2 answers 2026-08-18 Dalton: A / 8h / skip N/A / tries=2.
